Both arms retain slim source-relative upper-arm and forearm girth, coherent wrists, and two empty readable hands without generic chibi inflation.
Blonde-gold long loose hair preserves the tousled front and side silhouette and the single bound side fall.

The ochre-cream quilted outerwear, fitted underlayer, tapered trousers, high soft collar, uneven hems, bright-thread cuff repair, seams, closures, and nose stud remain continuous, but the summon’s clearly visible string-bound recipe leaf is absent instead of retained as a stowed accessory while both hands stay empty.

Original-resolution inspection places the complete top-of-hair-to-chin unit at approximately 34 percent of standing figure height, within the required 32–36 percent band and reading near 2.9 heads tall.
Exactly one subject appears with the complete hair mass, both empty hands, both legs, and both boots fully inside generous parchment margins.
The grounded three-quarter ready-idle, oversized adult head, compact torso, planted boots, open silhouette, and ochre-cream blocks remain clear at combat-icon scale without a weapon.

The repaired cloth presentation stays mortal and grounded with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, label, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect.
